dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: This place sure looks familiar. I might have blown up— Um, I mean, seen a house like this one before!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: Anyway, this place is huuuuge! We're gonna have lots of fun, I know it!

dialogues.speaker: Klee
dialogues.text: #{F#Miss}{M#Mr.} Honorary Knight, you can play with me, too!
